text.tspan: Apply in the PM after cleanser and toner/essence. Using 2-3
pumps, smooth onto dry face and neck. Gently tap into the
under-eye area. Follow with moisturizer.
Caution: Do not use other AHA products on the same night. Do
not use if pregnant or nursing.
“It's powerful enough that you still have to ease into using
but works well with sensitive skin.”
